name: Pain Spotter Public API
description: Programmatic, read-only access to AI-scored business opportunities mined from Reddit, Hacker News, Product Hunt, Stack Exchange and other open communities. Authenticate with an API key via the X-API-Key header. Quotas: Free 20 / Pro 1,000 / Business 5,000 calls per month (resets 1st of each month UTC). Get a key at https://painspotter.ai/account.
